summary: Indirect dispatch wrapper. Calls a function pointer stored at a1+12 with (a2, dword at a1+4) to obtain an index v4, then resolves a buffer via BufferIndexComputation on the dword at a1+16. When that buffer lookup returns -1 (failure sentinel) it falls back to a single-entry call through *(*(dword)a1 + 4*v4); otherwise it forwards v5 to CallChainWrapper. Called from four infrastructure/audio mixer paths.

local_names.a1: dispatch record whose slots select the call chain
local_names.a2: primary argument forwarded to the selected handler
local_names.v4: index produced by the leading function-pointer call

operations.description: Call the handler selected by the function pointer at a1+12, passing a2 and the dword at a1+4; store its return value as the index v4.
Resolve the target buffer index by calling BufferIndexComputation with the dword at a1+16 and two zero arguments; result stored in v5.
Branch on whether the computed buffer index v5 equals -1, selecting the single-entry fallback path versus the multi-entry call chain.
Fallback path: call SingleFunctionCallWrapper with the dword at (dword at a1) + 4*v4 and a2, and return its result.
Normal path: forward v5 to CallChainWrapper and return its result.
Return whichever handler result was taken; the function is reached from sub_563870, sub_564110, SingletonGlobalAccessorWithFallbackAlloc and AudioMixerPollingUpdateLoop.
